svg.title: AI Chatbot Complete Data Flow (DNS → TLS → Token Rate Limiting → LLM → MCP Tools → ESPN API)

g.text: (DNS → TLS → Token Rate Limiting → LLM → MCP Tools → ESPN API)
- Manages DNS records via Route53 API
- Separate traffic analysis for LLM usage
• AWS Load Balancer: Outside OpenShift Cluster
• OpenShift Router: SNI routing to correct Gateway
• Multiple Gateways: AI, MCP, External API
② AI Bot → External LLM (chat completion)
⑧ MCP Tool → External API Gateway (/nba)
⑨ ESPN Proxy → External ESPN API
⑩ Data flows back to AI Bot
⑪ AI Bot → LLM (second call with tool result)
• MCP Gateway for centralized tool access
• Multi-hop data flow (Browser → AI → LLM → MCP → ESPN)
• MCPGatewayExtension: Extends Gateway for MCP protocol
• Broker aggregates tools, router handles requests
